criterion: The Capability Instance is recorded in the capability register with a unique identifier, accountable owner and lifecycle status, and the record is approved by the named authority.
testMethod: DOCUMENT_REVIEW; INQUIRY: confirm register entry, owner and approval against delegation of authority

criterion: Each Service Outcome in the decision question has a measurable definition: metric, measurement point, tolerance and the operating states in which it applies.
testMethod: DOCUMENT_REVIEW; ANALYSIS: check each outcome for metric, measurement point, tolerance and states; any missing element fails the criterion

criterion: Criticality and impact tolerance are defined and approved per outcome, with the consequence basis recorded.
evidence: Criticality and impact-tolerance analysis; approval record
testMethod: DOCUMENT_REVIEW; INQUIRY: trace each tolerance to an approved consequence analysis

criterion: The operating envelope (load, environmental, duration and state-specific limits) for which outcomes are claimed is declared with parameter values.
testMethod: DOCUMENT_REVIEW; ANALYSIS: confirm each envelope parameter has a value, unit and basis

criterion: Every Service Outcome traces to at least one Required Function and to the architecture elements that implement it.
testMethod: RECONCILIATION: trace a sample of outcomes forward to architecture and architecture elements back to outcomes; untraced elements are recorded

criterion: The decision question states the decision to be supported, the accountable decision owner, the intended use and the as-of date or period.
evidence: Decision-question record in the assessment plan
testMethod: DOCUMENT_REVIEW: confirm all four elements are present and approved by the decision owner

criterion: The assessment boundary is documented and approved, listing included systems, locations and interfaces, and every exclusion with its rationale.
testMethod: DOCUMENT_REVIEW; INQUIRY: confirm approval and that each exclusion has rationale

criterion: Provider and tenant responsibility boundaries are documented at each demarcation point and agreed by both parties.
evidence: Demarcation schedule; contract extracts; signed RACI
testMethod: DOCUMENT_REVIEW; INSPECTION: verify demarcation points on site against the schedule

criterion: Current architecture records exist for every in-boundary system, each with version, date and approver.
evidence: Single-line diagrams, P&IDs, network and cluster topology records
testMethod: DOCUMENT_REVIEW: check presence, version and approval for each in-boundary system

criterion: As-built or as-configured reconciliation has been performed for each in-boundary system, and each discrepancy is recorded and dispositioned.
evidence: Reconciliation records; discrepancy log; configuration exports
testMethod: RECONCILIATION; SAMPLING; INSPECTION: compare a risk-based sample of physical and configured state with the architecture records

criterion: No component on which a Required Function depends lies outside the boundary unless it is recorded as an external dependency for evaluation under CG-03.
testMethod: ANALYSIS: trace Required Functions to components and compare with the boundary and external dependency list

criterion: Every interface crossing the boundary (power, water, network, management access) is enumerated with an owner on each side.
testMethod: DOCUMENT_REVIEW; INSPECTION: sample interfaces on site and confirm both owners

criterion: Every Required Function is mapped to the assets and systems that implement it, with upstream dependencies traced to the boundary or to a named external provider.
testMethod: ANALYSIS; RECONCILIATION: trace a sample of functions end to end and confirm each path terminates at the boundary or a named provider

criterion: Recovery dependencies (services, data, tools, spares, people and providers needed to restore each function) are mapped.
testMethod: DOCUMENT_REVIEW; ANALYSIS: compare with recovery procedures and confirm each prerequisite is mapped

criterion: Shared source, common controller, shared route and shared human dependencies are analysed for every redundancy claim used by a Service Outcome, and each common mode is recorded with consequence and disposition.
testMethod: ANALYSIS; INSPECTION: test a sample of claimed-independent paths for shared elements on drawings, configuration and site

criterion: Each external dependency has a documented provider, service terms, incident-notification obligations and evidence rights.
testMethod: DOCUMENT_REVIEW: verify terms and evidence rights for each material provider

criterion: Capacity, supplier and knowledge concentration is assessed, with substitution readiness recorded for each critical concentration.
testMethod: ANALYSIS; INQUIRY: confirm substitution options and lead times for each critical concentration

criterion: Every material dependency has a named accountable owner.
testMethod: DOCUMENT_REVIEW; INQUIRY: confirm with a sample of named owners

criterion: The dependency model is reconciled with configuration, topology and route evidence and is current against change records.
evidence: Configuration and topology exports; change records; reconciliation record
testMethod: RECONCILIATION: compare the model with exports and changes since the model date

criterion: Fire detection and suppression cover all in-boundary spaces, including battery rooms, generator and fuel areas and liquid-cooled halls, with current inspection and test records by a competent person and jurisdictional approvals where required.
evidence: Fire strategy; detection and suppression inspection/test records; approvals
testMethod: DOCUMENT_REVIEW; INSPECTION: walk down each space against the fire strategy and verify current test records

criterion: An arc-flash and shock risk assessment is current for the installed configuration, the protective-device settings it assumes match the installed settings, and equipment is labelled accordingly (assessed against the applicable regime, for example NFPA 70E with IEEE 1584 or national equivalents).
evidence: Arc-flash study; extracted device settings; labelling survey
testMethod: RECONCILIATION; INSPECTION: compare study assumptions with extracted settings and sample labels

criterion: Permit-to-work, lockout/tagout, method statements and competence authorisation are defined and evidenced in use for energised, hazardous-fluid and confined-space work.
evidence: Permits, LOTO records and method statements for a sample of completed work; competence register
testMethod: SAMPLING; DOCUMENT_REVIEW; OBSERVATION: trace a sample of hazardous work orders to permits, isolations and authorised persons

criterion: Battery thermal-runaway hazards are addressed for the installed chemistry: detection, ventilation or off-gas management, segregation and suppression, consistent with the applicable standard family (for example NFPA 855 or national equivalents).
evidence: Battery hazard assessment; room design; inspection records
testMethod: DOCUMENT_REVIEW; INSPECTION: verify measures in place against the hazard assessment

criterion: Refrigerants, coolants, fuels and suppressants are inventoried with safety data, leak detection where the hazard warrants, and handling and emergency procedures.
evidence: Hazardous-substance inventory; safety data; leak-detection records; procedures
testMethod: DOCUMENT_REVIEW; INSPECTION: sample inventory items on site and confirm detection and procedures

criterion: Egress and emergency access are unobstructed, and EPO and suppression interfaces cannot be actuated or inhibited without authority and record.
evidence: EPO and suppression-interface governance; inhibit logs; inspection
testMethod: INSPECTION; DOCUMENT_REVIEW: inspect EPO guarding and review inhibit/restore records

criterion: No open life-safety Finding classified as an imminent hazard exists without interim protection and duty-holder acceptance.
testMethod: DOCUMENT_REVIEW; INQUIRY: review open items with the duty holder

criterion: Every hazardous test proposed by the assessment has written authorisation, method statement, abort criteria and competent supervision before execution.
testMethod: DOCUMENT_REVIEW: verify before any test is executed; an unauthorised test is a Critical evidence nonconformance (AIDCF-008 §47)

criterion: For each power path, design and measured peak demand, including declared accelerator transient demand, are within the derated rating of utility connection, transformers, UPS, generation and distribution at the declared redundancy.
evidence: Capacity and load study; EPMS demand data; equipment ratings
testMethod: ANALYSIS; RECONCILIATION: compare measured peaks and declared transients with derated ratings per component

criterion: The declared redundancy is realised as built and preserved in MAINTENANCE states, and single points of failure are listed with disposition.
evidence: Single-line diagrams; switching procedures; SPOF register
testMethod: INSPECTION; ANALYSIS: walk each maintenance switching state on the SLD and confirm redundancy is preserved

criterion: A protection coordination study exists for the as-built configuration, installed settings match it, and selectivity is demonstrated for faults that would otherwise disconnect more than one redundant path.
evidence: Coordination study; settings extracted from relays and trip units
testMethod: RECONCILIATION; SAMPLING: compare extracted settings with the study for a risk-based sample of devices

criterion: UPS/BESS runtime at actual load and current battery state of health exceeds generator start-and-transfer time with the margin declared in the capability profile, demonstrated by test.
evidence: Runtime test records; battery state-of-health data; transfer timing records
testMethod: TEST; ANALYSIS: compare tested runtime at representative load with measured transfer time

criterion: On-site fuel autonomy at declared load meets the outcome's duration requirement, and replenishment arrangements (contracts, priority and access) are evidenced.
evidence: Fuel autonomy calculation; tank level records; replenishment contracts
testMethod: ANALYSIS; DOCUMENT_REVIEW: recompute autonomy from consumption data and verify contract terms

criterion: Voltage, harmonics and transient behaviour at IT and cooling loads are within equipment tolerance under measured operation, including load steps.
testMethod: ANALYSIS; TEST: review measurements over a representative period and at least one load-step test

criterion: Generator start, transfer, retransfer and restoration sequences have been tested at representative load within the evidence currency window, with anomalies closed.
evidence: Transfer and restoration test records; anomaly closure records
testMethod: DOCUMENT_REVIEW; REPERFORMANCE where authorised: review test records and anomaly closure

criterion: EPMS covers the critical electrical path with alarms reaching the operator, and preventive maintenance of that path is current with no deferred safety- or reliability-critical task.
evidence: EPMS point list and alarm records; maintenance and deferral records
testMethod: RECONCILIATION; SAMPLING: compare EPMS points with the SLD and sample maintenance records

criterion: The heat-load model reflects the declared envelope, including per-rack density and accelerator transient power, and allocates heat between air and liquid paths.
testMethod: ANALYSIS; RECONCILIATION: compare model inputs with the envelope and with measured rack power

criterion: Design and resilient capacity of each heat-removal stage at the declared redundancy and design ambient, after seasonal derating, exceeds the modelled load.
evidence: Capacity calculations; equipment data; derating basis
testMethod: ANALYSIS: recompute capacity per stage at design ambient with one unit (or the declared redundancy) out of service

criterion: Secondary-loop supply temperature, flow and differential pressure at the cold plates remain within the equipment manufacturer's specified envelope across measured operation, including at peak load.
evidence: CDU and loop telemetry over a representative period; manufacturer specification
testMethod: ANALYSIS; SAMPLING: review telemetry against the specification at recorded peak loads

criterion: Loss of a CDU, pump, chiller or power feed to cooling has been tested, or analysed where testing is unsafe, showing supply temperature stays within the envelope until redundant capacity or controlled throttling takes over, including cooling ride-through on power interruption.
evidence: Failover and ride-through test records or competent analysis
testMethod: TEST; SCENARIO_EXERCISE; ANALYSIS: review timed test results against the envelope

criterion: Water continuity for heat rejection and make-up water is evidenced for the outcome duration, including dependence on external water supply.
evidence: Water supply agreements; storage capacity and consumption data
testMethod: ANALYSIS; DOCUMENT_REVIEW: recompute autonomy from consumption data

criterion: Leak detection and isolation cover liquid-cooled racks, manifolds and quick disconnects, and isolation has been demonstrated.
evidence: Detection coverage drawings; leak-response test records
testMethod: INSPECTION; TEST: sample detection points and review isolation tests

criterion: Coolant chemistry, filtration and wetted-material compatibility are monitored against specification.
testMethod: DOCUMENT_REVIEW; ANALYSIS: review sample results against limits and actions taken

criterion: Thermal control is stable, critical sensors are calibrated or plausibility-checked, and maintenance states preserve the capacity claimed.
evidence: Control-trend records; calibration records; maintenance-state analysis
testMethod: ANALYSIS; SAMPLING: review control trends for oscillation and sample sensor calibrations

criterion: An inventory and architecture of BMS, EPMS, CDU controllers, PLC/SCADA and their networks exists and identifies every automated function that can change power, cooling or life-safety state.
testMethod: DOCUMENT_REVIEW; INSPECTION: sample field controllers and confirm they are in the inventory

criterion: Controller logic and setpoints are under configuration control with a current baseline, and running configuration matches the baseline on sampled controllers.
evidence: Logic and setpoint baselines; running-configuration exports
testMethod: RECONCILIATION; SAMPLING: compare running configuration with baseline for a risk-based sample

criterion: On loss of controller, network or power, each critical automated function goes to its declared safe state, demonstrated by test or acceptance-test records.
testMethod: TEST where authorised; DOCUMENT_REVIEW: review test evidence per function

criterion: No single controller, server or control network failure affects both redundant power or cooling paths.
testMethod: ANALYSIS; INSPECTION: trace both trains to their controllers and networks

criterion: Write and command authority to controllers is limited to authorised identities and logged; engineering workstations and remote access are controlled (evaluated with CG-15).
evidence: Access configuration; command logs; remote-access records
testMethod: RECONCILIATION; SAMPLING: compare accounts with authorised list and sample command logs

criterion: Critical alarms are rationalised, reach the operator and have a defined response.
evidence: Alarm rationalisation records; alarm logs; response procedures
testMethod: ANALYSIS; OBSERVATION: review alarm rates and trace a sample of critical alarms to response

criterion: Manual operation procedures for loss of automation exist and have been exercised.
testMethod: DOCUMENT_REVIEW; SCENARIO_EXERCISE: review records or observe a walkthrough

criterion: An approved baseline for accelerators, nodes, firmware, drivers and rack-scale composition exists, and fleet conformance to it is measured.
evidence: Baseline record; fleet inventory and conformance report
testMethod: RECONCILIATION; SAMPLING: compare fleet inventory with baseline per stratum

criterion: Usable accelerator capacity, net of failed, drained and reserved nodes, meets the capacity outcome over the assessment period.
evidence: Scheduler and health telemetry; capacity outcome
testMethod: ANALYSIS: compute usable capacity over the period against the outcome

criterion: As-configured fabric topology matches design, and path diversity, oversubscription and collective-communication performance meet the performance outcome on representative workloads.
evidence: Topology exports; path analysis; benchmark and production telemetry
testMethod: RECONCILIATION; TEST; ANALYSIS: compare exports with design and review representative benchmarks

criterion: Storage throughput, metadata performance and capacity headroom meet the data and checkpoint outcome, measured.
testMethod: ANALYSIS; TEST: review measured throughput and checkpoint duration at representative scale

criterion: Data and metadata integrity mechanisms (checksums, scrubbing) operate, and integrity errors are detected and handled.
evidence: Scrub and integrity-check records; error-handling records
testMethod: DOCUMENT_REVIEW; SAMPLING: confirm mechanisms enabled and sample error handling

criterion: Error and degradation detection for accelerators, links and storage media operates with defined drain and repair actions.
evidence: Error-detection configuration; drain and repair records
testMethod: RECONCILIATION; SAMPLING: trace a sample of detected errors to actions

criterion: Failure of a node, link or switch, or storage server within the declared fault domain has been tested and degrades performance within tolerance.
testMethod: TEST; SCENARIO_EXERCISE: review timed results against the performance tolerance

criterion: Fault domains are defined for power, cooling, compute, network, storage and control plane, with the outcome impact of losing each stated.
testMethod: DOCUMENT_REVIEW; ANALYSIS: confirm every domain type is defined with outcome impact

criterion: Containment boundaries are implemented as designed (electrical selectivity, cooling isolation, fabric partitioning, storage failure domains, control-plane segmentation).
evidence: Containment design; as-built and configuration evidence
testMethod: RECONCILIATION; INSPECTION: sample boundaries and compare with design

criterion: The blast radius of each credible single failure and each identified common mode is within the impact tolerance of the affected outcomes.
testMethod: ANALYSIS: compare computed impact with tolerance per scenario

criterion: Isolation is validated by test, by documented incident evidence or, where testing is unsafe, by competent analysis with stated limitations.
evidence: Isolation test records; incident records; analysis
testMethod: TEST; DOCUMENT_REVIEW; ANALYSIS: review validation per boundary

criterion: Cross-domain propagation paths are analysed for the compound scenarios relevant to the capability.
testMethod: ANALYSIS; SCENARIO_EXERCISE: trace each relevant scenario across domains

criterion: Workload and tenant segregation prevents a fault or contention in one partition from breaching another partition's tolerance.
evidence: Partitioning and isolation configuration; contention telemetry
testMethod: RECONCILIATION; ANALYSIS: review configuration and contention evidence

criterion: Recovery outcomes (recovery-time and recovery-point tolerances and minimum service outcome) exist for each Service Outcome in scope.
testMethod: DOCUMENT_REVIEW: confirm tolerances per outcome

criterion: Recovery dependencies and sequencing for power, cooling, compute, storage, network and control plane are documented and mutually consistent.
evidence: Recovery plans; dependency and sequence maps
testMethod: ANALYSIS: check sequences for circular or missing prerequisites across domains

criterion: Configuration-restoration sources are current, integrity protected and restorable independently of the failed environment.
evidence: Backup and image inventory; integrity records; restore tests
testMethod: RECONCILIATION; TEST: compare backups with current configuration and review independent restore

criterion: Checkpoint durability and an immutable recovery copy exist, and restore to a usable training state has been demonstrated.
evidence: Checkpoint and immutable-copy configuration; restore test records
testMethod: TEST; DOCUMENT_REVIEW: review restore to a resumed job at representative scale

criterion: Recovery has been exercised through component tests and at least one integrated cross-domain scenario at representative scale within the evidence currency window, with measured times compared against tolerance.
testMethod: SCENARIO_EXERCISE; DOCUMENT_REVIEW: compare measured times with tolerances

criterion: Defects from exercises are tracked to closure with retest.
testMethod: SAMPLING: trace a sample of defects to closure and retest

criterion: Spares, vendor support and staff required for recovery are available within the recovery time.
evidence: Spares inventory; support contracts; staffing rota
testMethod: DOCUMENT_REVIEW; INQUIRY: compare availability with recovery-time assumptions

criterion: Every decisive claim has a recorded EvidenceAssessment with quality vector, sufficiency against the profile floor and reviewer.
testMethod: RECONCILIATION: compare the decisive-claim list with recorded assessments

criterion: No decisive claim is recorded CONFORMING or PARTIAL on a package below its sufficiency floor or with a mandatory item below its quality floor.
testMethod: ANALYSIS; SAMPLING: re-evaluate a risk-based sample of decisive claims against their floors

criterion: Mandatory items are present, or substituted only by a listed acceptable alternative with approval rationale.
testMethod: RECONCILIATION: compare manifests with profile mandatory items

criterion: Duplicate lineage is not counted as corroboration, and AI-generated or derived content is not used as independent corroboration of its own sources.
testMethod: ANALYSIS: trace lineage of corroborating items for a sample of decisive claims

criterion: No Critical evidence nonconformance (fabrication, falsification, concealed conflict, custody breach affecting a critical claim) exists.
testMethod: DOCUMENT_REVIEW; INQUIRY; ANALYSIS of custody events for decisive evidence

criterion: An immutable EvidenceManifest exists for the decision snapshot and references all evidence underlying decisive claims.
testMethod: RECONCILIATION: verify manifest integrity and completeness against decisive claims

criterion: Every UNKNOWN result, gate UNKNOWN and evidence gap has an UNKNOWN Record with type, severity and the determining test.
evidence: UNKNOWN register; control and gate results
testMethod: RECONCILIATION: compare UNKNOWN results and gaps with register entries

criterion: Every US3, US4 and US5 severity has been reviewed by the independent reviewer, and no severity has been downgraded without new evidence or an approved boundary change.
testMethod: DOCUMENT_REVIEW: verify review and justification for each downgrade

criterion: Every US4 and US5 UNKNOWN has a disposition (resolved, approved boundary change, or carried with owner, evidence request, target date and ceiling).
testMethod: DOCUMENT_REVIEW: confirm disposition fields complete for each US4/US5

criterion: No UNKNOWN is encoded as pass, zero, NOT_APPLICABLE or accepted risk in results, scores or reports.
testMethod: ANALYSIS: automated and sampled checks of encodings

criterion: US4 and US5 UNKNOWNs are reported in the decision record and assurance statement with their effect.
testMethod: RECONCILIATION: compare register with decision record and statement

criterion: Every Required Function and every material dependency has a named accountable owner (role and individual).
testMethod: RECONCILIATION: compare functions and dependencies with owner assignments

criterion: Provider, tenant and operator responsibilities at each boundary interface are allocated in contract or agreed RACI, including during incidents and maintenance.
testMethod: DOCUMENT_REVIEW: verify allocation per interface and state

criterion: Decision rights for operating-state transitions (generator transfer, emergency shutdown, workload throttling, load shedding) are assigned and known to operations staff.
testMethod: DOCUMENT_REVIEW; INQUIRY: corroborate with a sample of shift staff

criterion: Risk-acceptance authority is defined with limits, and every accepted risk is signed by a holder of that authority.
testMethod: SAMPLING: compare signatories of accepted risks with delegations

criterion: 24x7 escalation paths are defined and have been tested.
evidence: Escalation procedure; test or exercise records
testMethod: DOCUMENT_REVIEW; SCENARIO_EXERCISE: review escalation tests

criterion: The Assurance Decision has a named accountable decision owner with authority for the decision question who is independent of the assessment team.
testMethod: DOCUMENT_REVIEW; INQUIRY: confirm authority and independence

criterion: Configuration baselines exist for in-scope facility and IT systems.
testMethod: DOCUMENT_REVIEW: confirm baseline per system with version and date

criterion: Material changes since the evidence observation dates are identified by reconciling change records with configuration and telemetry evidence.
evidence: Change records; configuration and telemetry evidence
testMethod: RECONCILIATION: detect unrecorded changes by comparing configuration over time

criterion: Each material change has an impact assessment covering capacity, redundancy, protection, fault domain and recovery effects, and approval by the authorised party.
testMethod: SAMPLING: review a risk-based sample of material changes

criterion: Changes were tested, with a rollback plan and recorded post-change validation.
testMethod: SAMPLING; DOCUMENT_REVIEW: trace sampled changes to validation

criterion: Temporary configurations are registered, time-bound, and removed or converted under change control.
testMethod: INSPECTION; RECONCILIATION: compare site state with the register

criterion: Emergency changes are retrospectively reviewed and approved.
testMethod: DOCUMENT_REVIEW: confirm reviews for all emergency changes in the period

criterion: Evidence affected by a material change is marked STALE and dependent Control Assessments are reopened.
evidence: Evidence lifecycle records; assessment reopen records
testMethod: RECONCILIATION: compare changes with evidence status

criterion: Identities (human, machine, vendor and automation) able to issue consequential commands to facility control systems, cluster managers, fabric or storage controllers and out-of-band management are inventoried.
testMethod: RECONCILIATION: compare entitlements on target systems with the inventory

criterion: Privileged and break-glass access is least-privilege, approved, time-bound and logged.
testMethod: SAMPLING: trace a sample of privileged sessions to approvals

criterion: Management and control planes are segmented from tenant and corporate networks, and reachability analysis shows no unapproved path to consequential control functions.
evidence: Segmentation design; firewall and routing configuration; reachability analysis
testMethod: ANALYSIS; TEST where authorised: verify reachability against approved paths

criterion: Remote and third-party access requires activation, approval, session monitoring and timely revocation.
evidence: Remote-access records; session recordings or logs; revocation records
testMethod: SAMPLING: trace a sample of vendor sessions end to end

criterion: Automated and AI-enabled actions on infrastructure are bounded by allowlists, approval controls and safe rollback.
evidence: Automation authority configuration; approval records; rollback tests
testMethod: RECONCILIATION; TEST: compare permitted actions with allowlists and review rollback tests

criterion: Authentication and command activity on control planes is monitored, with defined response.
evidence: Detection coverage map; alert and response records
testMethod: ANALYSIS; SAMPLING: confirm coverage and sample responses

criterion: Recovery of identity and control-plane authority after loss of the identity provider or credential compromise is planned and tested.
testMethod: SCENARIO_EXERCISE; DOCUMENT_REVIEW: review exercise results
